name: agent402
description: Open-source MCP server: 500+ tools AI agents call and pay for per request, in USDC over x402 or MPP, by prepaid card credits, or free via proof-of-work for pure-compute tools. Web search and rendering, PDFs, OCR, SEC filings, market and crypto data, and utilities. Most tools are deterministic code; model-backed tools are marked as such.
